task: Driving License Application in New Delhi

step_1.title: Register on Parivahan
step_1.chatText: Go to the Parivahan website and click on 'New User' to register. You will need a valid Aadhaar card and a mobile number.

aadhaar_doc.title: Aadhaar Card
aadhaar_doc.chatText: A valid Aadhaar card is required for identity verification.

mobile_doc.title: Valid Mobile Number
mobile_doc.chatText: Required for OTP verification on the Parivahan portal.

step_2.title: Fill Online Application
step_2.chatText: Log in and click 'Apply for Driving License'. Fill the form and upload the required documents.

address_proof.title: Address Proof
address_proof.chatText: Acceptable documents include utility bills, lease agreements, etc.

photo_doc.title: Passport Photograph
photo_doc.chatText: Recent passport-sized photograph for the license.

step_3.title: Pay Fees
step_3.chatText: Pay the application fees online (approx. Rs. 200-300).

step_4.title: Visit RTO Office
step_4.chatText: Print the application form and visit the New Delhi RTO to submit it along with physical copies.
